title: Heteroscedastic Neural Network Regression: · Gaussian Negative Log-Likelihood Loss
prompt:
**Heteroscedastic Neural Network Regression:** Instead of outputting a single point prediction $\hat{y}(x)$, how do you train a neural network to output both the mean $\mu_\theta(x)$ and input-dependent variance $\sigma_\theta^2(x)$ using **Gaussian Negative Log-Likelihood Loss**:

$$\mathcal{L} = \frac{1}{2} \log \sigma_\theta^2(x) + \frac{(y - \mu_\theta(x))^2}{2 \sigma_\theta^2(x)}$$
